content: There is NO Indian Knowledge or Education System, it's Only a Brahmin Education System. There is NO EWS Quota, there is Only a "Gareeb Brahmin" Quota. (Creamy layer issue). If you use the Mandal Philosophy of Socially, Educationally, and Economically Backward, then: Brahmins are Economically Backward but Socially and Educationally Forward. Bania and Kshatriya aren't as Educationally Forward as Brahmins, so if Economic criteria become mainstream, then it will increase the representation of Brahmins and mostly MALEs. Most educational systems were designed by the British but later Sanskritised by Brahmins post-Independence. EPISTEMOLOGY is BRAHMINICAL, that's why the value of rattafication is very high and the focus on material reality is lower. Whenever people talk about preserving Indian knowledge systems or rediscovering Indian knowledge systems, they mostly are talking about preserving the Brahminical Education System.
